evidence.title: 2026 Solutions for Congested Corridors Program Guidelines Adoption, Resolution G-26-60

accessibility.note: PDF metadata reports a tagged document and text extraction was readable; this record does not make an accessibility conformance claim.

evidence.editorialSummary: Commission staff's August 20–21, 2026 meeting book item (Reference 4.6, Tab 19) recommends adoption of the 2026 Solutions for Congested Corridors Program Guidelines and states that the Accessibility evaluation criterion in Part IV, Section 17.2.2 was amended pursuant to Order 5 of Executive Order N-7-26 to emphasize first- and last-mile connectivity to transit infrastructure; the proposed guidelines are attached as Attachment B.

directiveLinks.excerpt: Pursuant to Executive Order N-7-26 (Order #5), signed June 26, 2026, the Accessibility evaluation criterion was amended to emphasize the delivery of first- and last-mile connectivity to transit infrastructure.

locations: Page 2: staff memorandum, Accessibility heading, Part IV, Section 17.2.2 summary of changes

limitations: This is a staff recommendation published before the August 20–21, 2026 meeting. It does not establish that Resolution G-26-60 was adopted, that the attached guidelines took effect, or that any other program named in directive 5 changed; an adoption record would be a separate artifact.
The explicit citation appears in the staff memorandum's summary of changes. The attached guideline text (Attachment B) was not separately reviewed line by line for order citations in this record.

The record covers only the SCCP state-guideline clause of directive 5. It does not address the Local Partnership Competitive Program (a separate book item), ATP, TIRCP, or Caltrans's federal-funding-identification clause, and it does not establish completion, compliance, or agency performance.
